$comment: B9 of the code provenance review (docs/CODE_PROVENANCE_REVIEW_2026-09-28.md, section 5.3; D144): every image, font, video, audio or archive file under the application root that git tracks, or would commit, has exactly one entry here, saying which script generated it or which upstream, version and licence it came from. An entry names its files by a pattern ('*' within one folder, '**' across folders) and states how many it covers. test/unit/binary-provenance.test.ts fails on a file no entry covers, a file two entries cover and an entry whose count differs, so a new binary is explained here before it lands. Checked at 0.1.0's release candidate (W5D): 118 files.
